_comment: Third-party apps built into the image, pinned. prebuilt_apps.py fetches each
APK and licence into /dlcache (checked against these sha256s), and generates
the modules in vendor/jetson-tv/PrebuiltApps. The binaries never enter this
repo. Each is shipped exactly as its authors signed it, so their own later
releases still install over it as updates. 'source' is what a published
image must point to for the GPL: see docs/prebuilt-apps.md.
uses_libs/optional_uses_libs must match the APK's <uses-library> tags (aapt2 dump badging), or Soong refuses it.

apps.name: Kodi
apps.source: https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/tree/21.2-Omega (d1a1d48c3cb3722d39264ffdd8132f755ffecd27), plus the third-party tarballs tools/depends builds it with
